title: Naturally Fabulous
body:
# Naturally Fabulous
Naturally Fabulous is a highly optomized, vanilla-like modpack that aims to expand on the vanilla version of minecraft with new furinture, beautiful biomes, agriculture, and more. You can go on a camping trip, run a 5 star resturaunt, go hunting, decorate 'till your heart's content, and so much more.

Built with Fabulously Optomized as the foundation, Naturally Fabulous is highly optomized and preformant. If you're going to use shaders (which look beautiful with our modpack), we recommend using settings equivelent to BSL Shaders at medium settings for stable preformance.

Since Naturally Fabulous is currently still in alpha, you may potentially encounter some bugs and unintended behaviours. If you find a bug, it would be very appriciated if you could help out and report it in the [_issue tracker_](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdMyNVITGbP74Wp3dw_n6TrMT1SaNSosWRoowgTpStt08EfLg/viewform?usp=dialog).
